item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Expands Technology-Focused Summer Learning
item.description: PolyU’s 2026 International Summer School and Summer Institute offer students hands-on, technology-driven learning in science, AI, sustainability and innovation, fostering global academic engagement and skills development.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Foundations Empower Fisheries Management
item.description: Vietnam is rapidly modernising fisheries management and actively combating illegal fishing through integrated digital systems, improving transparency, sustainability and compliance across the sector.

item.title: Singapore: Operation Cyber Guardian Boosts Telecom Resilience
item.description: Singapore launched Operation Cyber Guardian, a multi-agency effort with telcos, to contain sophisticated state-linked cyberattacks and strengthen protection of critical telecommunications and essential services.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Advances Physical AI for Mobility, Robotics
item.description: Selangor is advancing Physical Artificial Intelligence in 2026, focusing on AI-enabled semiconductors, autonomous mobility, robotics and testbeds to drive innovation, talent and infrastructure.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Platforms Improve Public Service Delivery
item.description: The Philippines is rapidly accelerating digital transformation across civil registry and business services, using innovative online platforms to significantly improve efficiency, accessibility and transparency nationwide.

item.title: Australia: CQUniversity AI Boosts Neuroscience Research
item.description: CQUniversity researchers apply artificial intelligence to automate brain organoid image analysis, improving accuracy, consistency and speed in neuroscience research.

item.title: India: Digital and Smart Agriculture Drive Resilient Farming
item.description: India is strengthening farm incomes and climate resilience through sustainable practices, mechanisation, crop insurance and a growing digital agriculture ecosystem powered by data, AI and farmer-centric services.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Develops Real-Time Weld Monitoring Tech
item.description: PolyU’s IntraSpect™ combines optical sensing and artificial intelligence to enable real-time internal weld monitoring and proactive defect prevention.

item.title: Vietnam: New Law Strengthens Robust E-Commerce Growth
item.description: Vietnam’s new E-Commerce Law strengthens consumer protection, tightens platform accountability and sets clearer rules to support safer, transparent and sustainable growth of the country’s rapidly expanding online market.

item.title: Singapore: Updated Digital Roadmap Strengthens Food Manufacturing
item.description: EnterpriseSG and IMDA have refreshed the Food Manufacturing Industry Digital Plan, guiding over 1,500 businesses to adopt digital and AI solutions to boost productivity, resilience and sustainable growth.
